mapping.summary: Touch screen for operators to run operations and post time, output, scrap and consumption.
claims: Operators see only operations for their own assigned work centers
Start, pause, resume and finish operations with live timers
Setup time recorded separately from run time
Reports produced quantity, output scrap and extra component consumption
Postings go through standard BC journals and routing statuses
Creates inventory movements for an operation's components and blocks completion until registered
Material log compares theoretical and reported consumption before booking
Scheduled breaks pause and resume running operations automatically
Records clock-in, clock-out and non-production time
Several operators can register on one operation individually
Order and operation notes from the floor are saved on the production order
Logs every start, pause, note, posting and status change per operator
Shop floor users do not need extra full BC licenses
Needs the uTools Base Application and a uTools subscription
